project_overview: 警察案件跟踪系统，提供案件注册、调查、起诉、搜索等功能

functions.name: SearchCase
acceptance_criteria: 搜索结果应在5-8秒内返回（简单搜索）
搜索结果应在10-15秒内返回（高级搜索）
搜索结果不应包含用户无权访问的记录
functions.preconditions: 用户已登录并具有搜索权限

functions.name: ViewCase
acceptance_criteria: 最近2个月内访问过的案件应在5-8秒内显示
最近2个月内未访问过的案件应在20秒内显示
functions.preconditions: 用户已登录并具有查看权限

constraints.description: 系统必须能够在5-8秒内执行简单搜索，在10-15秒内执行高级搜索
constraints.source_text: The System must be able to perform a simple search within 5-8 seconds and a advanced search (multiple search criteria) within 10-15 seconds regardless of the storage capacity or number of cases in the system. In this context, performing a search means returning a result list. It does not include retrieving the records themselves.

constraints.description: 系统必须能够在5-8秒内检索并显示过去2个月内访问过的案件
constraints.source_text: The System must be able to retrieve and display within 5-8 seconds the case which has been accessed within the previous 2 months, regardless of storage capacity or number of cases in the system. This requirement is intended to allow for rapid retrieval of frequently-used cases, on the understanding that frequency of use is typically correlated with recent use.

constraints.description: 系统必须能够在20秒内检索并显示过去2个月内未访问过的案件
constraints.source_text: The System must be able to retrieve and display within 20 seconds the case which has not been accessed within the previous 2 months, regardless of storage capacity or number of cases in the system. This requirement is intended to allow for cases where cases used infrequently are stored on slower media than more active records.

constraints.description: 系统在搜索结果列表中绝不能包含用户无权访问的任何记录
constraints.source_text: If a user performs a quick or advanced search, the System must never include in the search result list any record which the user does not have the right to access.

constraints.description: 系统应使用缓存存储频繁使用的数据
constraints.source_text: Use of cache for storing frequent data

constraints.description: 搜索结果应从数据库中以10或20个为一批获取
constraints.source_text: The search results should be fetched from the database in batches of 10 or 20 maximum as configured within the application

constraints.description: 搜索应仅获取需要显示给用户的字段
constraints.source_text: The search should fetch only the fields that need to be displayed to the user. Only when the user clicks on a particular record to view its further details should a query be fired to fetch the additional details for this particular record only

constraints.description: 应在用于搜索的关键列上应用数据库索引
constraints.source_text: Database Indexes should be applied on the key columns used for searching

constraints.description: 应配置和使用分层缓存来缓存最频繁使用的搜索结果
constraints.source_text: A hierarchical cache should be configured and used for caching of results of most frequently used searches

exceptions.trigger: 用户尝试访问或搜索没有权限的案件
exceptions.handling: 根据配置返回不同响应：显示标题和元数据/仅显示案件存在/不显示任何信息

exceptions.trigger: 搜索操作超过规定时间限制
exceptions.handling: 返回错误信息并建议用户优化搜索条件

non_functional_requirements.description: 系统必须可扩展，不能有任何功能会妨碍在不同规模的警察局使用
系统必须记录用户对案件的无权访问尝试到审计跟踪中
系统用户界面必须适合有特殊需求的用户
